name: GET /api/routing-rules - List routing rules in evaluation order
description: Returns routing rules ordered by ascending evaluation_order then creation time - the exact order the routing engine evaluates them in, so what QA sees is what the engine does. Pass active=true to omit deactivated rules. Protected by the authenticate guard; the Authorization header is required on this GET. QA: depends on register, login and at least one created rule so the list is non-empty.

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
